description: Intentional `Schema.Unknown` and `Schema.Array(Schema.Unknown)` payloads in the HttpApi contract. Each entry is justified per `specs/effect-tui/10-contracts-errors-security.md` and the open-payload policy at `packages/nikcli/AGENTS.md`. New entries require a docblock on the producer, an EOT-10 owner, and a runtime/consumer test. The CI script `script/check-open-payloads.ts` fails if a `Schema.Unknown` appears in `src/server/httpapi/` that is not listed here. Entries are keyed by file plus the declaring line's text, never by line number: a line number turns every unrelated edit above a listed site into a CI failure, and re-numbering an allowlist is not review. `count` is the number of identical declarations in that file (omitted when it is 1).

qualifies: genuine opaque passthroughs (third-party APIs, mobile/host capability surfaces)
polymorphic event-sourced entries (sync events, journal events)
discriminated-envelope `properties` where the runtime check on `type` selects a concrete schema
typed `Record<string, unknown>` metadata / data / options fields (encodes as `{ [k: string]: unknown }`, not as `any`)
disqualifies: any payload the service defines in zod/effect-schema that should be reused

entries.justification: AppLogInput.extra is `Record<string, unknown>` — arbitrary per-call metadata attached to a log entry.
Config field — provider-specific typed map; the schema is `Record<string, unknown>`.
ConfigDataResponse.data is `Record<string, unknown>` — the full config document.
ConfigProviderInfo.options is `Record<string, unknown>` — per-provider configuration map.
ConnectorAuth data is `Record<string, unknown>` — opaque per-connector auth state.
AuthGroup config is the provider-specific OAuth config; per-provider typed variants would force a parallel schema.
AccountSuccess is the OAuth/account result; shape varies by provider (PKCE, passkey, device-code).
JournalEvent is the share journal envelope; the consumer replays it on the share target.
MCP update payload is `Record<string, unknown>` — the per-server update body, structurally typed by the MCP layer.
Pty connect upgrade — no body.
DiscordSetupOutput.data is `Record<string, unknown>` — opaque Discord API response data.
Experimental worktree.parameters is the per-tool input schema; tool registry is the source of truth.
Loop data field — opaque loop run data.
Mission data field — opaque mission metadata.
host.browser capability surface — per-session opaque capability record from the host layer.
Mobile session event stream.
mobile.github.repos returns the upstream GitHub REST repo object. Restating the third-party schema is exactly the drift the exception is for.
WebSocket upgrade response carries no body.
PermissionRequest.metadata is `Record<string, unknown>` — tool/agent-provided context.
Pty data field — opaque per-Pty state.
SessionV2EntryList — entries persist first, V1 is derived; the entry shape is event-sourced.
SessionV2EventList — same polymorphic-event rationale.
SessionV2State — runtime state machine is open-ended; client renders it via projector.
SessionNotFoundError.data — error envelope, `Record<string, unknown>`.
SessionPart.github is the GitHub payload attached to a part; shape varies by event type.
Message.parts is a heterogeneous part array; each part has its own schema and the consumer projects per `_tag`.
SessionPart.permissions is the runtime-collected permission set for a part; the producer (`src/permission/next.ts`) is typed but the consumer (renderer) projects dynamically.

SyncEventRecord.data is event-sourced; the consumer projects each `type` via the registered projector (`src/sync/sync-event.ts`). Restating every payload schema in the contract would double the maintenance cost without adding runtime safety.
StatsEvent is the raw stats payload; same polymorphic-event rationale.
OutboxResponse.events is the event payload array — same rationale as SyncEventRecord.data.
SnapshotResponse.state is the per-aggregate replay snapshot; aggregates vary by id prefix and the projector is the source of truth.
Sync SSE stream frame — heterogeneous envelopes.
Top-level command options is `Record<string, unknown>` — opaque per-command option map.
Command template body is shell-evaluated by the runtime; the server does not interpret it.
TuiConfigInfo rest entries — `Record<string, unknown>` for additional TUI config keys not in the core schema.
TuiRequest.body is relayed verbatim to the terminal; the server never interprets it.
TuiNotFoundError.data — error envelope, `Record<string, unknown>`.
TuiValidationError.data is opaque — the original request body that failed validation.
TuiValidationError.error is the underlying validation failure message.
TuiPublishInput.properties — the runtime check on `type` decides which `TuiEventPayload` to parse against (see tui.ts:51-57 docblock).
WorkspaceRestore.events — the workspace's pending sync events, projected on restore.
